mentions.name: Death Document
mentions.description: A free, anonymous, tracking-free guide for documenting the important details of a person's life — banking, insurance, property, investments and other personal information — so it's available when they die. It can be downloaded as a document for offline use, with no tracking, and a hosted version is a possibility for the future.
mentions.problem: Essential end-of-life information (banking, insurance, property, investments) is often kept in ad-hoc places like a phone note, and there was no comprehensive, easy-to-use guide for documenting a complicated life for when you die.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The past couple months I've been working on a more comprehensive, easy-to-use guide to document our (for better or worse) complicated lives and I'm just starting to show people.

It's free. It's anonymous. There's no tracking. Download the document if you want to work offline.
